description: This file implements the CurrencyHttpClient class, which provides methods to asynchronously fetch currency metadata and ratios, using mock data for testing purposes. It includes initialization, mock data definitions, and exception handling for simulated network failures.

classes.name: CurrencyHttpClient
classes.description: A client class for fetching currency data asynchronously, with support for simulated network failures and mock data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the client with source currency code and response language.

methods.name: GetCurrencyMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves currency metadata, returning a future with the data or throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: GetCurrencyRatiosAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves currency ratios, returning a future with the data or throwing an exception on failure.
